metadata.title: Curvature property on Hermitian Lie algebras with abelian ideals of codimension two
metadata.abstract: Let $(\mathfrak g,J,g)$ be a unimodular Hermitian Lie algebra containing an abelian ideal $\mathfrak a$ of real codimension two. We study the curvature behaviour of $g$ and show that, if $g$ has constant Chern holomorphic sectional curvature, then it must be Chern flat. We also show that, for every canonical metric connection $D_s^r$ of $g$ other than the Chern connection, if $D_s^r$ has constant holomorphic sectional curvature, then $g$ is Kähler flat, and in this case $\mathfrak g/\mathfrak a$ is abelian.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 余维二阿贝尔理想的曲率刚性
analysis.workSummary: 对含实余维二阿贝尔理想的幺模 Hermitian 李代数，证明常 Chern 全纯截面曲率强制 Chern 平坦。
analysis.breakthrough: 对其余典范联络进一步强制 Kähler 平坦，分清 Chern 联络的特殊性。
analysis.limitations: 要求幺模性和余维二阿贝尔理想；不覆盖任意 Hermitian 李代数。
